saw_lines: Parents buying a car seat research for weeks, check it fits their car, then trust the brand that explains the safety.
So the sale is won on the car fit guarantee and shipping answer, before a parent reaches the cart.
Your site already promises a car fit guarantee and free shipping over a set order value, so put that promise in the first line of your next ads.
ads_1: Car fit guarantee leads, tested against the rear facing safety story
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Twitter
